description: PAID ($0.60). Check an invoice in one call: is the VAT right (place of supply, rate, expected amount vs vat_charged), is it overdue and how much statutory late interest is owed, and do seller/buyer tax IDs pass the official format check. Seller countries here: BS, CA, CR, HN, MX, PA, SV. Send due_date, or invoice_date with terms_days. Anything we cannot answer in full is refused free (coverage_gap, no_charge). Shares the 3 free calls per IP per day with the answer tools. Pass api_key if you have one (card checkout at /pricing); otherwise the result is the x402 payment requirement. Optional receipt (boolean, default false): on a paid success, include an Ed25519 answer receipt at no extra USDC. An answer receipt is not a series certified extract (GET /v1/certified/{country}/{series} is $0.10 and is not an MCP tool) and is not legal advice. Verify with verify_answer_receipt against /certified/public-key.

api_key.description: API key (bypasses x402; metered for invoicing)

buyer_country.description: ISO code; omit for a domestic invoice

invoice_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; with terms_days instead of due_date

receipt.description: Default false. When true, a paid success includes an Ed25519 answer receipt (kind answer_receipt) at no extra USDC. Unpaid 402 and free refusals do not include one. Not a series certified extract (GET /v1/certified/{country}/{series} at $0.10; that SKU is not an MCP tool).

seller_country.description: ISO country code of the seller

vat_charged.description: VAT amount on the invoice, to be checked

name: invoice_check

outputSchema.description: Finished-job dossier: verdict or summary, line items, evidence with official sources. On 402 the x402 PaymentRequired object (isError)

error.description: Present on a free refusal or error; no charge

payment_required.description: true when the call needs payment; how_to_pay explains x402 or card
